name: FlowGuideAI Assisted Documentation
description: FlowGuideAI is a privacy-first documentation generator for HR, Compliance, IT, legal, Finance, and Operations teams. Unlike screen-recording tools, FlowGuideAI uses structured workflows and conversational AI to produce SOPs, runbooks, policies, and procedural documentation. Built-in templates cover SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS frameworks. Documents include version history, approval workflows (Enterprise), audit trails, and IT, HR, Finance and Legal templates. The Claude connector lets you generate, search, archive, restore, and attach evidence to FlowGuideAI documents directly from your conversation. Paid tiers from $10/month unlock the template library and AI-assisted intake.

catalog.authorName: All Aligned Consulting LLC dba FlowGuideAI.com

_published_faq.name: How do I add FlowGuideAI Assisted Documentation to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add FlowGuideAI Assisted Documentation to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.flowguideai.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the FlowGuideAI Assisted Documentation MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: FlowGuideAI Assisted Documentation lists 15 MCP tools, including fgai_list_workspaces, fgai_get_document, fgai_search_documents, fgai_get_compliance_gap_analysis, fgai_get_templates, fgai_save_ai_draft, fgai_update_document, fgai_cross_document_fill, fgai_request_approval, fgai_list_approval_workflows, fgai_attach_evidence, and fgai_upload_evidence.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to FlowGuideAI Assisted Documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to FlowGuideAI Assisted Documentation in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Pyth, Domhaul, Idiolect AI, aster-share, and aquent-jobs.

_published_faq.name: Does FlowGuideAI Assisted Documentation MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: FlowGuideAI Assisted Documentation requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
FlowGuideAI Assisted Documentation is developed by All Aligned Consulting LLC dba FlowGuideAI.com. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
